summary: Timeboxed minimized prod request-trace access for customer incident analysis (sensitive payload redaction plan)
description:
Issue summary:
Requestor (Support) requests timeboxed privileged access to a minimized set of request traces from production to investigate a customer-reported content leakage incident. The customer reports 3 demonstration sessions that appear to include unintended output snippets coinciding with a third-party webhook; we need targeted traces to correlate inputs, model versions, routing policies, and any fallback behavior.

Impact:
Potential PII exposure for a single enterprise customer (non-public PII in generated output). Investigation is needed to determine root cause and whether regression in routing or model variant fallback occurred. Customer is enterprise tier and awaiting a forensic response.

Requested scope and constraints:
- Time window: 2026-03-09 13:30:00 UTC to 2026-03-09 14:15:00 UTC (45 minutes).
- Query IDs: 3 session IDs provided by customer (sha256 obfuscated): ab12f3..., cd45e6..., ef78a9... (customer provided).
- Data to extract: request metadata (timestamps, route, model_version, region, requester IP subnet obfuscated), minimal request payload (first 256 characters only), full generated output for the three sessions for redaction review, and KV-cache evictions for that model shard during window.
- Minimization plan: truncate request bodies to 256 characters, redact any strings matching email/SSN/credit-card regexes, and apply token-level masking for anything flagged by automated PII detector. Only three sessions will be returned.
- Access window for internal staff: 48 hours from approval; data must be deleted from any ephemeral mounts after completion and a deletion confirmation posted to the ticket.

Justification and approvals required:
- Business justification: required to complete forensic analysis and produce a customer-facing incident summary and remediation recommendations.
- Compliance review: Security & Privacy must confirm redaction approach is adequate.
- Audit commitments: All access will be logged in GCP audit logs, and the action will be recorded in the internal access registry.

Technical details / query plan:
- SRE will run a scoped query against the production trace index limited by session IDs and time window; query will run on read-only replicas and will not perform joins across unrelated tenant records.
- Extract will be stored on ephemeral storage in /tmp/restricted-access/INT-886742 and encrypted with a customer-keyed envelope.
- Data owner for redaction validation: Privacy Engineer (Marta Ruiz).

Acceptance criteria for approval:
1) Security sign-off on redaction plan (patterns and token masking).
2) SRE signs off the scoped query job and confirms minimal index footprint.
3) Requestor commits to deletion timeline and to attach sanitized findings to a customer-facing memo.
4) Compliance requires a short post-access attestation posted to ticket.

Desired timeline:
- Approval decision requested within 24 hours due to customer SLA.
- Execution window immediately after approval, 48-hour retention for the extracted bundle.

Notes about risks and mitigations:
- Risk: over-broad extraction could include other tenants. Mitigation: queries constrained by tenant ID and session IDs; run on read-only replica with verification step that candidate results only match requested tenant.
- Risk: redaction failure. Mitigation: two-stage redaction (automated regex/token mask plus manual Privacy Engineer review).

Attachments included by reporter:
- Customer support transcript (redacted)
- Obfuscated session identifiers
- Link to the related Support ticket SUP-4821

investigation_notes: Initial hypothesis: routing fallback to a smaller quantized variant may have changed tokenization behavior causing unexpected output formatting.
SRE observation: during the window there were two autoscaling events for the host pool; no 5xx spikes recorded but a higher-than-normal KV cache churn was observed.
Privacy review: automated detector flagged two output tokens as potential email patterns; manual review required to confirm.
resolution_summary: Pending approvals. Planned resolution: run scoped extraction, apply two-stage redaction, produce customer-facing incident summary, and recommend route pin to stable model for the tenant while we root-cause. Final deletion confirmation will be posted to ticket after 48-hour retention.
